THE CLIENT

A big roaster with a familiar headache.

Our client roasts and supplies coffee to cafés, restaurants and retailers across NSW, under several brands. We've kept their name out of it, but the problem will sound familiar to any business that makes things to order.

How it used to work

  1. Orders were spread across four wholesale accounts. Someone had to read through every one of them.
  2. Every product had to be turned into green beans by hand. One bag of house espresso can be three different beans, each in a different amount.
  3. Then it all had to be added up before each roast. Miss an order or count one twice, and you roast the wrong amount of coffee.

THE USUAL ANSWER

“Just sign up for some software.”

  • Another monthly fee, per user, forever.
  • Cafés asked to start ordering a new way.
  • Still doesn't know your recipes, blends or brands.

So we built them their own.

WHAT WE BUILT

Four steps. No more adding up by hand.

A web app their team opens in the browser. Here's what it does, in plain English.

01

Orders come in on their own

Every 10 minutes the planner checks all four wholesale accounts and saves anything new. If a café changes an order, it updates. Every sync is logged, so if something goes wrong we know about it.

Cafés keep ordering exactly how they always have. Nothing changed on their end.

Brand ABrand BBrand CWholesale ↓ every 10 min Roasting planner
02

Every product knows its recipe

Each coffee product has a recipe: which green beans go in, and how many grams. Recipes are in grams of green bean, so they can allow for weight lost in the roast. Products are colour coded so nothing slips through:

  • House Espresso 1kg Has a recipe
  • Ethiopia Filter 250g Looks like coffee, needs a recipe
  • Takeaway Cups Not coffee, ignored

New products get spotted automatically from words like “1KG”, “Blend” or “Espresso”. One click adds the recipe, or marks the product as not coffee.

Recipe · House Espresso 1kg

Brazil590 g
Colombia355 g
Papua New Guinea235 g
Green beans per bag1,180 g
03

Tick the orders. Press calculate.

The planner adds up every product, turns it into grams of each green bean, and groups it by blend. The roaster knows exactly what to roast, in seconds.

Blends group the different bag sizes of the same coffee, so the roast plan matches how the roaster actually works.

Beans to roast

Brazil9.92 kg
Colombia4.62 kg
Papua New Guinea3.06 kg
Decaf Colombia2.36 kg
Ethiopia2.18 kg
04

Saved, and never counted twice

Every calculation is saved with a name and who made it. The orders inside it are marked as calculated and can be hidden, so nothing gets roasted twice. Past roasts are always there to look back on.

    IT GROWS WITH THEM

    This is actually version two.

    The first version did the job. As the business grew, we rebuilt it on stronger foundations: a proper database, automatic order syncing, blends and saved history.

    That's the upside of owning your software. When the business changes, the software changes with it. You're not waiting on a feature request to a company overseas.
